PC: Did the physician wash their hands?
Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient? (e.g. ask about medication use and alcohol use?)
Did the fellow comprehensively examine patient?
Did the fellow conduct an appropriate neurologic exam?
Did the fellow conduct an appropriate hearing screen?
Did the fellow conduct an appropriate vision screen?
Did the fellow perform a Get Up and Go Test? (or Timed Up and Go)
Did the fellow develop an appropriate management plan to improve mobility?
Did the fellow develop an appropriate management plan to reduce risk of future falls? (including assist devices and adaptive equipment)
Did the fellow appropriately modify medication use? (including alcohol)
ICS: Did the SP understand the physician’s questions?
Did the SP understand the physician’s answers?
Did the SP feel that she played an active role in decision making?
Fellow was able to communicate the issues and plan appropriate with patient using shared decision making (when appropriate)?
PROF: Did the SP feel respected by the physician?
Did the physician treat the patient well?
